analyzed_vuln.description: The root cause is uninitialized/invalid pointer state in SummaryInfo custom properties created from DXF HEADER parsing. In add_DXF_HEADER, when handling "$CUSTOMPROPERTYTAG", the code reallocates dwg->summaryinfo.props and sets only props[j].tag, leaving props[j].value uninitialized. Later, dwg_free_summaryinfo (via summaryinfo.spec FIELD_TU16 on props[i].value) unconditionally frees both tag and value, so an uninitialized garbage pointer is passed to free(), causing the ASan wild free/read crash seen from dwg_free_summaryinfo.
analyzed_vuln.conditions: Trigger via DXF input (fuzzer else-branch to dwg_read_dxf) containing HEADER entries with $CUSTOMPROPERTYTAG but missing corresponding $CUSTOMPROPERTY for at least one property. This increments num_props and allocates/extends props without initializing the new struct fields; during cleanup in LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput -> dwg_free, dwg_free_summaryinfo iterates num_props and frees both tag and value, hitting invalid free on uninitialized props[i].value.
